subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these exact final revisions of actions that execute with GitHub App private keys, registry credentials, and OpenAI API credentials in privileged workflows?
rationale: This is a supply-chain trust decision about third-party code executed with repository secrets and publishing authority; a mechanical patch review cannot safely choose the repository's accepted action provenance policy.

options.title: Approve final pinned revisions
options.body: Verify the exact final SHAs against the intended upstream releases and approve after the outstanding workflow results are acceptable.

options.title: Split privileged action upgrades
options.body: Keep lower-risk setup and labeling updates separate, and submit secret-bearing, publishing, and Codex-action revisions for dedicated security review.

options.title: Pause this Dependabot batch
options.body: Close or defer the batch if the team does not want to approve the combined trusted-action update as one security boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve final pinned revisions
recommendation.body: Verify the exact final SHAs against the intended upstream releases and approve after the outstanding workflow results are acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: Most likely available decision route for repository-wide privileged workflow and release automation changes.
